title: scene drafts: invalid ULIDs/required fields in examples
description: 8 ids starting 01J5OBJ in draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md and draft-atwood-jmap-scene-wss-00.md are not ULIDs (Crockford base32 excludes O). draft-atwood-jmap-scene-wss-00.md:899 callIds value is 25 chars, not 26. Both PushSubscription/set examples (draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md:2556,:2577) omit deviceClientId, which RFC 8620 7.2 requires.
close_reason: Fixed in scene-00/scene-wss per 2026-10-20 decisions; log scratchpad/audit/scene00-fix.md and scenewss-fix.md; guides synced.
